description: The most primal and instinctive authority. Exclusive to Generators and Manifesting Generators.
decision_style: Gut-level, immediate response. A literal 'uh-huh' (yes) or 'uh-uh' (no) that arises in the body before the mind engages. Works best in real-time, responsive situations.
time_to_decide: Immediate. Sacral responses are in-the-moment. If you have to think about it, it's no longer sacral.
career_application: Trust the gut response when evaluating job offers, projects, and collaborations. If your body doesn't light up with an 'uh-huh', it's probably not right. Avoid overriding the sacral with mental justification.
common_mistake: Overriding the gut response with mental reasoning ('but it pays well / looks good on the resume / is what I should want').
